_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Vibration Survey Report
summary: The Vibration Survey Report documents vibration survey test results used to identify resonant conditions and assess acceleration forces for equipment readiness before environmental stress screening and reliability testing.
use_relationship:
This report covers the results of specified vibration surveys tests performed on equipment to determine if any resonant condition exists within the equipment, and also the magnitude of resulting acceleration forces as they relate to possible over stress of assemblies or components. The report will be used by the procuring activity to determine the readiness of the equipment for environment stress screening (ESS) and reliability tests.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task equipment for this data included in the contract.

This DID supercedes DI-NDTI-81587.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format:
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the test data obtained during specified vibration survey tests and shall include:

children.title: Description of the vibration survey test, including the following:
Levels and axis of imposed vibration
Techniques used to perform the survey and record accelerometer output.
Vibration check of fixtures to assure there are no fixture resonances in the vibration test frequency range.
Vibration sweep rate and dwell time at resonances.
Rationale for selection of items monitored by sensors.
Vibration measurements taken, under specified test conditions, of the vibration response of the structural package itself, and of integral parts/subassemblies internally mounted.

A comparison of the vibration data taken during vibration tests with the vibration data determined analytically or the vibration limits recommended by the manufacturer of the part or by the contractor.
Description and identification of equipment under test, date of test, and location of the test facility.
Methods and test equipment/instrumentation used to perform the survey including manufacturer, model number, serial number, and accuracies.
Identification of any resonant condition exhibited during the vibration test.
Magnitude of the acceleration forces resulting from the resonant condition as they relate to possible over stress of assemblies or components.
Description of corrective actions taken or proposed.
